title: AEGISClaimEvidenceSchema
description: Formal claim and forensic evidence schema for the AEGIS Debate & Arbitration Protocol.

claim_id.description: UUID or unique identifier for the specific claim instance.

job_id.description: Correlation UUID matching the parent ingestion/orchestration job.

detector_id.description: The detector service producing this forensic claim.

model_version.description: Version identifier of the detector model (e.g. 'efficientnet-b0-v1.0', 'rppg-chrom-v1.0', 'syncnet-v1.3').

domain.description: The biological, physical, or algorithmic modality domain of the evidence.

polarity.description: Forensic polarity assertion of this detector signal.

confidence.description: Normalized confidence score where 0.0 = Authentic, 1.0 = Synthetic/Deepfake.

raw_score.description: Unnormalized raw metric or logit from model inference (e.g., frame offset, spectral purity, logit).

claim.description: Human-readable forensic claim summarizing the primary finding.

flags.description: Diagnostic and heuristic flags triggered during feature extraction or scoring.

observational_metrics.description: Domain-specific quantitative metrics extracted from the input media.

attenuation_factors.description: Environmental and quality discount factors applied to this claim (1.0 = nominal, < 1.0 = degraded).

coverage_gap.description: True if the detector could not evaluate due to missing prerequisites (e.g. silent video, occluded face).

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the raw features, frame crops, or intermediate tensors for court admissibility.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of claim generation.
